title: Made this endless running 2d game for my nephew and nieces to play; built for android/ios; tried to make it as kid friendly as possible
author: PM_ME_PICS_OF_UR_PS3
selftext: Never got around to releasing it, even made the ad implementations for it.

comments.author: PM_ME_PICS_OF_UR_PS3
comments.body:
This took about a month to make; 2-3 hours a night; 

Another reason it’s not releasing is due to copyright sound effects I was suppose to remove but haven’t gotten around to it

replies.author: hawtdawtz
replies.body: If this took you more than several hours with AI I’m going to be honest you might not be cut out to be releasing games

replies.author: PM_ME_PICS_OF_UR_PS3
replies.body: That’s cool and all but I don’t care what randos on Reddit think

replies.author: dancemiasma
replies.body: Then why did you post this if you don't care to hear anyone's feedback?

replies.author: BuildAnything4
replies.body: yeah, before AI, I would have said this is a good effort for someone with no programming experience to do in a month. Different story now.

replies.author: steelbottom_
replies.body:
> a month

Goddamn. I feel a little better.

replies.author: PM_ME_PICS_OF_UR_PS3
replies.body: Time flies when ur having fun

comments.author: Three_Tails_Studio
comments.body: The first 3-5 seconds of any video is the most critical and you choose to show us the audio controls. Then after that, the menu system. It isnt until 32 seconds in that we see actual gameplay. Pretty wild right?

replies.author: PM_ME_PICS_OF_UR_PS3
replies.body: Who cares about the first 3-5 seconds for a project that won’t go commercial? Just wanted to show what I was working on, sorry this isn’t the triple A trailer you’d hoping it would be

replies.author: BuildAnything4
replies.body: why'd you put in ads then

replies.author: PM_ME_PICS_OF_UR_PS3
replies.body: There was a point where I wanted to release it and this video is the only one I had in my phone library at this time; I could’ve re-exported without ads and recorded a whole new video, but what’s the point?

replies.author: hawtdawtz
replies.body: The points that you had mentioned it wouldn’t go commercial lol

replies.author: PM_ME_PICS_OF_UR_PS3
replies.body: There was a time where I wanted it go commercial, then I gave up on the project and worked on others

replies.author: Three_Tails_Studio
replies.body: You said you even made the ad implementations for it and then you say it wont go commercial. Seems you are just as confused as this trailer is.

replies.author: PM_ME_PICS_OF_UR_PS3
replies.body: What’s so confusing about adding ad implementations for a game to test it out and never release the project? Did critical thinking go out the window in this sub?

replies.author: hawtdawtz
replies.body: No I think we’re just tired of bottom of the barrel recreations of the world simplest game that could have been created in a few hours being paraded around. We’re not trying to be mean, but at the end of the day when you look at the stuff posted here you thought “hey, they’re going to love this”?

replies.author: PM_ME_PICS_OF_UR_PS3
replies.body: Sounds like this ai vibe coding thing is your livelihood, personally I could care less, I’m just here to have fun and tinker with ai and work on projects I think it’s cool and share them on this sub.

replies.author: hawtdawtz
replies.body: Fair, sorry to take the wind out of your sails! Unfortunately Reddit in general isn’t really interested in people who are breaking into things for the first time. Usually there’s a pretty high bar and expectation

replies.author: PM_ME_PICS_OF_UR_PS3
replies.body: Your problem is caring about what randos on Reddit think.

replies.author: hawtdawtz
replies.body: I mean you keep replying.

replies.author: PM_ME_PICS_OF_UR_PS3
replies.body: Because I love talking

replies.body: \*Couldn't

replies.author: PM_ME_PICS_OF_UR_PS3
replies.body: Even mods couldn’t stand your previous comment and you’re still here, I don’t swing that way unfortunately

replies.body: Wild this dude has kids 🥺

replies.author: PM_ME_PICS_OF_UR_PS3
replies.body:
I had a hunch your reading comprehension was poor, thank you for confirming it. 

“Never argue with stupid people, they will drag you down to their level and beat you with experience”
